outcome.observable_success: A keyboard-selected tool expands below its transcript row with a bounded detail view, then returns the operator to the composer.
primary_journey: Launch Z Agent in an interactive TTY
Prompt the configured model to perform a read-only tool invocation
Press Tab, Enter, Right, and Esc
Observe inline Summary and Output, then editable composer focus

environment: Linux pseudo-TTY; Node 22.20.0; configured local model; isolated /tmp working directory

manual_checks.name: real TTY inline inspector journey
manual_checks.limitation: Tool navigation requires a configured provider and a real terminal, so the pseudo-TTY sequence is recorded manually alongside deterministic TUI tests.

residual_risks: The manual TTY proof used a read-only tool; confirmation priority remains automated-test coverage.
The pseudo-TTY did not simulate a physical terminal resize while streaming.
